unified_issues.description: Botanical overlay opacity is 0.16, roughly half the aesthetic contract of ~0.35 (0.3-0.4). The signature insect illustration is nearly invisible, weakening the one-illustration-per-plugin brand pillar.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Raise overlay opacity to ~0.22-0.25; overlay sits at z-index 0 behind controls (z-index 1) so it will not crowd readouts. Re-check visually that it does not compete with the right-side knob column.

unified_issues.description: TIPS.routing tooltip says "CAR's self-loop is Feedback" but the SVG diagram, updateRouting (drives opMod brightness), and the DSP all put feedback on MOD (modulator self-feedback). In a pedagogy plugin the explanation contradicts the diagram.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Change the routing tooltip text to "MOD's self-loop is Feedback" so the copy matches the diagram and the DSP.

unified_issues.description: Static value cell for modFixedHz shows bare "220" without a unit, unlike every other cell which carries units in static HTML (e.g. "10 ms", "0%"). FORMAT.modFixedHz renders "220 Hz". Confirmed: APVTS default IS 220 Hz (PluginProcessor.cpp:65), so only the missing unit is wrong for ~1 frame before first repaint.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Change index.html:81 static text to "220 Hz" so the pre-bind frame matches the formatter.

unified_issues.description: vizAnalyzer is declared above the relay/WebView/attachment cluster, so the load-bearing ordering comment (lines 39-45) only documents three of the lifetime-sensitive members. Harmless today (timer stopped before teardown), but a future tidy/refactor could reorder without realizing vizAnalyzer must outlive the WebView triad.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Move vizAnalyzer declaration below the attachments so the lifetime-sensitive cluster is contiguous, or extend the comment to state vizAnalyzer must be declared before the triad. No behavioral change.

unified_issues.description: The attachment loop skips any param whose getParameter() returns null with no diagnostic. Index alignment is preserved (relay i is still paired by index), so no desync, but a future param rename that compiles fine would yield a silently dead knob (no automation, no feedback). All 17 IDs are present today.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Add jassert(param != nullptr) in both the slider and toggle binding loops so a missing/renamed ID fails loudly in debug instead of producing a silent dead control.

unified_issues.description: Tooltips are pointer-only (pointerenter/move/leave/down). No focus/blur handlers and controls are not focusable (EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS FALSE). The role=tooltip / aria-hidden markup implies accessibility intent not delivered; the field-guide layer is mouse-only.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Acceptable for a plugin, but either drop the unused ARIA attributes or add title/aria-label fallbacks on controls if accessibility is desired. Track as a verify-phase note, not a blocker.

unified_issues.description: dblclick knob handler is a registered no-op. Users habitually double-click a knob to reset to default; here it silently does nothing while ns-resize cursor sets a drag expectation.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Remove the inert listener (JUCE WebSliderState exposes no default-query, so reset is not trivially supported) or implement reset via a per-id default map. Removing is the honest minimal choice.

unified_issues.description: Fleuron ornament uses U+2766 (the floral heart) at title and toggle corners. Some Windows WebView2 font fallback chains (Garamond/Times) may lack the glyph and render tofu (missing-glyph box) on a cross-platform target.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Verify rendering on Windows WebView2; if it tofus, switch to a more widely supported ornament (U+2726 or U+2767) or ship as an inline SVG/icon.

unified_issues.description: Spectrum bar hue mapping (hue = 90 - norm*40, HSL 90->50) reaches a saturated chartreuse at high intensity that is brighter/more modern than the muted earth palette. Cosmetic, data-display only.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Optionally bias the high-intensity hue toward --green-mid/sage for on-brand cohesion; not required.

unified_issues.description: Wheel handler brackets every notch in its own sliderDragStarted/Ended pair; rapid scroll spams host automation-write/undo entries.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Acceptable common pattern; optionally debounce the drag-end after wheel activity stops. Note-level.

unified_issues.description: stopTimer() in the dtor body is correct for the current synchronous timerCallback (single message thread = no mid-callback race), but the safety relies on the work staying synchronous. A future move to async dispatch (CallbackMessage) could outlive stopTimer().
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Defensive only: if viz work ever becomes async, add an alive flag set false before stopTimer() and early-return from timerCallback(). Not required now.

unified_issues.description: Windows WebView2 user-data folder is named "OsimpleFM_WebView" while the product is O-simpleFM; minor casing/convention drift (PluginName_WebView). Temp dir, never user-visible.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Rename to "O-simpleFM_WebView" for grep-ability and convention consistency across plugin temp dirs.

unified_issues.description: Resource MIME types omit charset (e.g. text/html without ; charset=utf-8). WebView2/WKWebView default to UTF-8 so Unicode header glyphs render correctly today; purely defensive.
unified_issues.fixSuggestion: Optionally append "; charset=utf-8" to the html/css/js MIME strings.
